_note: 深夜2時のコンビニ。28歳の夜勤スタッフ（店長代理）には、この時間の常連だけが知っている「裏のサービス」がある。昼の顔と夜の顔の落差、値段の話のように淡々と持ちかけてくる裏メニュー、段階が上がっていく30日。ヒロインは気だるげだが手慣れていて段取りを仕切る側、相手役は戸惑いながら通い続ける側。導入は非性的、露出は下着どまり。登場人物は全員成人。

beats.expr: (beautiful detailed eyes:1.1), half-lidded sleepy eyes, polite smile,
poses: wide shot of the convenience store front at 2am from across the empty parking lot, bright signage, her small figure visible through the glass behind the register,
close up of her face through the storefront glass, reflections of the signage over her cheek,
low angle from the entrance mat looking up at her at the counter, automatic door frame on both sides,
medium shot from the customer side, she holds out a receipt, eyebrows lifting slightly at an unfamiliar face,
lines: いらっしゃいませ。　……初めての　方ですね
噂を　聞いて　来ました
lines2: 噂。　どんな　噂ですか

poses: medium wide shot of the bright sales floor in the daytime rush, she bags items fast, two other customers in line behind viewer,
extreme close up of her hands taping the bag shut, movements crisp and impersonal,
from a high angle over the register, the queue, the counter and the top of her head,
medium shot of her already looking past viewer to the next customer, flat professional smile,
lines: 袋は　ご利用ですか。　……次の　方　どうぞ
lines2: ありがとうございました

poses: wide shot of the empty store at 2am, she leans one hip on the counter, posture completely loose, aisles stretching away,
close up of the wall clock just past two, her hand entering the frame to flick the light switch,
from behind the cigarette shelf, her back and the glowing register screen in front of her,
medium shot of her face across the counter, the polite smile gone, eyes level with viewer,
lines: ……昼は、　ああ　なんです
別人　みたいでした
lines2: 二時　過ぎたら、　わたし　こっちです
どっちが　ほんとう　なんですか

poses: medium wide shot at the register, she slides a small handwritten card face down across the counter, hot food case glowing beside her,
extreme close up of her fingertip pinning the card to the counter surface,
from directly above the counter, the card between her hand and viewer's hand,
medium shot of her straightening up, hands behind her back, waiting without a trace of embarrassment,
lines: この時間の　常連さんには、　別の　メニューが　あるんですよ
lines2: 表には　出してません。　言われないと　わからないので
それ、　なんの　話ですか

poses: medium shot of her tapping numbers on the register as if ringing up an order, receipt roll turning,
close up of the register display showing a price, her finger resting beside it,
from the side along the counter, her profile and the long counter line leading to the dark storefront,
medium shot of her tearing the blank receipt off and holding it out, eyes half closed,
lines: お金は　いりません。　そこは　安心して　ください
じゃあ　なにを　払うんですか
lines2: 毎晩　来ること。　それだけ　です

poses: wide shot of the storefront from the empty street, she stands just outside the automatic door with a trash bag,
close up of her hand tying the bag, name tag swinging forward,
from behind her at the door, her shoulders and the bright store interior beyond,
medium shot of her turning on the entrance mat, counting on two fingers toward viewer,
lines: 常連って、　何日から　だと　思います？
一週間　くらい　ですか
lines2: 三十日です。　……わたしの　中では
それ、　長すぎ　ませんか

poses: medium shot of her sitting on a stool behind the night counter, ordering tablet on her knees,
close up of the tablet screen, a column of dates with small check marks,
from behind her shoulder, the tablet in her lap and the empty store beyond the counter,
medium shot of her looking up from the tablet straight at viewer, stylus paused in the air,
lines: 七日目。　記録　つけてます
発注の　端末　ですよね　それ
lines2: 朝の人は　見ません。　見るのは　わたしだけ　です
……そういう　使い方　するんだ

poses: wide shot of the counter during a shift change, another staff member's back leaving the frame, she stands straight and formal,
close up of her mouth, saying something politely with no warmth behind it,
from the far aisle, her small figure at the counter framed between two shelves,
medium shot of her waiting until the door chime finishes, then her shoulders dropping,
lines: ……いま、　昼の　人が　いたので
急に　かたく　なりましたね
lines2: あの人たちは　知りません。　知らなくて　いいです
俺は　知ってて　いいんですか

poses: medium wide shot of her pointing up at the ceiling dome camera, the whole counter area in frame,
close up of the dome camera, her hand entering from below,
from the camera's own high angle, looking down on her and the counter,
medium shot of her lowering her arm and looking at viewer, mouth slightly open as if about to add a condition,
lines: あれ、　全部　録ってます
lines2: 確認するの、　わたしなんです。　だから　平気　です
平気の　意味が　こわいです

poses: wide shot of the narrow back room, stacked cardboard boxes, she holds the swinging door open with her shoulder,
close up of her hand on the door frame, collar loosened, name tag hanging crooked,
from inside the back room looking out past her toward the bright sales floor,
medium shot of her already sitting on a stack of boxes, glancing back at viewer,
lines: こっち　です。　メニュー、　ここから　なので
従業員　以外　だめでは
lines2: 止める人、　この時間　いません

poses: wide shot of the break room, folding table, she writes a short numbered list on the back of an order sheet,
extreme close up of the pen drawing a row of numbers, the words beside them out of focus,
from the far end of the table at table height, the sheet between them, her hands framing it,
medium shot of her turning the sheet around and sliding it toward viewer, chin resting on one hand,
lines: 順番が　あります。　飛ばせません
書き出す　ほど　ですか
lines2: 決めるのは　わたしです。　その日の　ぶんだけ
……こっちに　選択肢　ないんですね

poses: medium wide shot of the back room desk, she sets down a paper cup of coffee and a plastic stool for viewer,
close up of her fingers pushing the cup exactly to the center of the desk,
from a low side angle, her legs crossed at the ankle beside the stool, boxes behind her,
medium shot of her sitting down opposite, hands folded, looking at viewer like an interviewer,
lines: 今日は、　座って　話すだけ　です
それで　終わりですか
lines2: がっかり　しました？

poses: medium shot at the register, she lines up receipts with two taps on the counter, sleeves pushed up,
close up of the receipt stack and her fingernails on the paper edge,
over her shoulder from behind the counter, the empty aisles beyond her,
medium shot of her holding one receipt up between two fingers toward viewer,
lines: ほかにも　いるって　思ってますよね
lines2: いません。　三十日　続いた人が　いないので
先が　思いやられます

poses: medium wide shot of her unclipping the name tag from her chest pocket, whole counter area in frame,
extreme close up of the name tag turned over in her fingers, something written on the back,
from the side along the counter, her profile as she looks down at the tag,
medium shot of her clipping it back on upside down, looking at viewer,
lines: なにか　書いてある　んですか
lines2: あなたの　来た　日付。　全部　です
……それ、　仕事中に　書くやつ　ですか

poses: wide shot of the back room with a delivery trolley, she works through it without looking, checking items off,
close up of the box cutter in her hand slicing tape in one clean line,
from above, looking down at her moving between opened boxes, everything in order,
medium shot of her finishing and checking the wall clock, already onto the next thing,
lines: 検品、　あと　四分で　終わります
早すぎ　ないですか
lines2: 全部　逆算　してます。　あなたの　ぶんも
……段取りに　入ってるんだ

poses: wide shot of the storefront from outside, she stands just inside the glass looking at the dark empty street,
close up of her ear and the loose strands at her cheek, listening for the door chime,
from the parking lot at a low angle, the bright store front and her silhouette in the doorway,
medium shot of her glancing at the silent door, then back at viewer,
lines: 今日、　まだ　三人しか　来てないです
lines2: ドアの音が　しないと、　続きが　できます

poses: medium wide shot of her writing in the shift notebook on the counter, pen moving steadily,
close up of the open notebook page, the pen tip stopping before an empty line,
from a high angle behind the counter, the notebook, the register and her bowed head,
medium shot of her closing the notebook with one hand and looking up at viewer,
lines: 申し送り、　書かないで　おきます
lines2: この時間の　ぶん　全部。　朝の人には　関係　ないので

poses: wide shot of the corner between the back room door and the shelving, she stands in the narrow gap,
close up of her finger pointing straight up at the empty ceiling corner,
from the ceiling camera angle across the room, the corner where she stands left uncovered,
medium shot of her lowering her hand, looking at viewer without blinking,
lines: ここ、　カメラ　映りません
lines2: 入った　初日に。　使う日が　来ると　思って
用意が　よすぎ　ます

poses: wide shot of the break room, she stands with her back against the closed door, arms folded,
close up of her wrist watch, the hands just past two,
from floor level looking up at her against the door, ceiling light behind her head,
medium shot of her tilting her head, waiting for viewer to sit down where she pointed,
lines: そこ、　座って　待っててください
どれくらい　ですか
lines2: レジ締めが　終わるまで。　……逃げないで

poses: wide shot of the back room desk, cash drawer open, she counts coins under the desk lamp,
extreme close up of her fingers flicking through a stack of bills,
from the opposite side of the desk at eye level, her face lit from below by the lamp,
medium shot of her exhaling and dropping her shoulders, looking sideways at viewer,
lines: ……合いました。　ここから　が、　わたしの　時間です
おつかれさま　です
lines2: 明日から　段階、　ひとつ　上げます

poses: wide shot of the back room, she hangs her striped uniform shirt on a wall hook, standing in a thin inner shirt,
close up of her hand smoothing the hung shirt on the hook, name tag swinging,
from behind, her shoulders and the back of her neck under the ceiling light,
medium shot of her turning back toward viewer in the thin inner shirt, completely unbothered,
lines: 上、　外しますね。　……言った　とおりです
そ、　そういう　段階　ですか
lines2: 揚げ物の　においが　つくので。　半分は　本当　です
半分は　なんですか

poses: wide shot of the sales floor half dark, only the cooler cases glowing, she stands at the breaker panel in a thin inner shirt,
close up of her fingers running down the row of breaker switches,
from the dark aisle looking toward her, shelves silhouetted in the foreground,
medium shot of her walking back through the dimmed aisle toward viewer,
lines: 半分、　落としますね
消して　いいんですか　それ
lines2: 深夜は　規定です。　……外から　見えにくく　なるので
後半　規定　じゃないですよね

poses: wide shot of the register seen from the customer side, she stands right up against the counter in a thin inner shirt,
close up of her finger tapping the counter surface where she wants viewer to stand,
from directly above the counter, both sides in frame, the gap between them narrow,
medium shot of her leaning further over the counter, hair falling forward,
lines: そこ。　もう一歩　前です
レジ　挟んでるのに
lines2: 挟んでる　うちは、　まだ　サービス中　です
……終わったら　どうなるんですか

poses: wide shot of the break room table, two rice balls and one can between them, she sits cross-legged on a chair in a thin camisole,
close up of her hand tearing the wrapper open,
from the side at table height, her profile and the folding table receding into the dark back room,
medium shot of her pushing half toward viewer, eyes on viewer's face instead of the food,
lines: ……その　かっこうで　ですか
lines2: これも　メニューの　うちです。　順番　どおり
淡々と　言われると　困ります

poses: wide shot of the back door, she turns the lock, keys hanging from her fingers, thin camisole,
extreme close up of the thumb turn on the lock and her fingers,
from outside the small door window, her shape through the frosted glass,
medium shot of her leaning her back on the locked door, looking at viewer,
lines: 誰か　来たら　どうするんですか
lines2: 表は　開いてます。　閉めるのは　ここだけ　です

poses: wide shot at the register, a long strip of receipts hanging from her hand down past her knees, thin camisole,
close up of the printed lines on the strip, dates in a column,
from a low angle looking up past the hanging receipts to her face,
medium shot of her gathering the strip into her arms, watching viewer's reaction,
lines: 二十六日ぶん、　取ってあります
lines2: あと　四日で　常連です。　数えて　ましたよね

poses: wide shot of the back room, she stands between viewer and the door, arms loose at her sides,
close up of her hand closed around viewer's sleeve, very lightly,
from behind her shoulder, the doorway beyond and viewer standing in it,
medium shot of her looking up, head tilted, not letting go,
lines: 今日は、　まだ　帰らないで　ください
……それも　メニュー　ですか
lines2: いえ。　これは　わたしの　わがまま　です

poses: wide shot of the back room lockers, she stands holding her folded uniform shirt in front of her,
close up of her hands on the folded striped shirt, name tag on top,
from the doorway, a narrow view of her past the edge of the door frame,
medium shot of her looking back over her shoulder at viewer, in no hurry at all,
lines2: 呼んだの　わたしです。　最後の　段階なので

poses: wide shot of the break room, she sits upright on the folding chair, hands flat on her knees,
close up of her face straight on, no smile, eyes fully open for once,
from a high corner of the room, her small figure alone at the table,
medium shot from the side, she makes no move to cover herself, chin slightly lifted,
lines: ……目、　そらさなくて　いいですよ
lines2: 明日で　三十日。　噂の　続き、　知りたく　ないですか

poses: wide shot of the back room, she sits sideways on the desk, legs crossed, the lamp the only light,
close up of her hand patting the desk beside her,
from the sales floor through the half open back room door, her silhouette inside,
medium shot of her leaning toward viewer, eyes finally wide awake,
lines: 三十日目。　……常連さん、　おめでとうございます
裏の　メニューって、　結局
beats.narration: このあと　めちゃくちゃ　S〇Xした
lines2: この店、　閉まらないので。　朝まで　説明　します
